name: com.makespdf/makespdf
description: Compliant PDFs (PDF/A-2A + PDF/UA-1) from markdown or a compact DSL - fast, no headless browser.

tools.name: render_markdown
tools.description: Create a PDF document from markdown text. Use when the user asks for a PDF of written content, such as notes, a report, a summary, a letter, a list, a checklist or a diagram. Supports GitHub-flavored markdown, tables, task lists, Mermaid diagrams (flowcharts, sequence and other diagram types), code highlighting and images; the output is a tagged, accessible PDF (PDF/A-2A + PDF/UA-1). Uses the user's makesPDF credits: 1 credit per 10 pages. Returns JSON metadata (pageCount, creditsDeducted, creditsRemaining, artifactId, downloadUrl) plus the PDF bytes as an embedded base64 resource and a resource_link to `downloadUrl`. On the Free and Hobbyist plans, unless the account holds Growth credits, each page carries a small makespdf.com link. Mirrors POST /api/v1/md.

markdown.description: The GitHub-flavored markdown document to render. YAML frontmatter may set the same keys as `options`. Up to 200KB of text; inline data: image payloads do not count toward that.

options.description: Optional render settings. Anything omitted falls back to YAML frontmatter in the markdown, then to the runtime default.

fontFamily.description: Body font: 'Inter' (geometric sans) or 'NotoSans' (humanist sans). Code blocks always use a monospace font.

fontSize.description: Body text size in points. Headings, spacing and line height scale from it.

margins.description: Page margins in points, [top, right, bottom, left]. When omitted, frontmatter `margins` applies, else 40 on every side.

theme.description: Visual style. 'github': lighter semibold headings, underlined h1/h2, zebra-striped bordered tables. 'default': heavier bold headings with no underlines or striping.

splitMode.description: How sections break across pages. 'default' keeps each section together where it can; 'balanced' splits large sections to fill pages and leave fewer gaps.

pageNumbers.description: Footer page-number format: 'page-n-of-total' (Page 3 of 12), 'n-of-total' (3 / 12), or 'n' (3). Omit for no page numbers.

pageNumberPosition.description: Footer alignment of the page number. Ignored without pageNumbers.

title.description: Document title written to the PDF metadata. PDF viewers show it in the window title instead of the file name. When omitted, frontmatter `title` applies, else 'Document'.

author.description: Document author, written to the PDF metadata.

subject.description: One-line summary of the document, written to the PDF metadata.

keywords.description: Search keywords, written to the PDF metadata.

tools.name: render_template
tools.description: Create a PDF from a stored template (a curated makesPDF library template or one the user saved) filled with the user's data. Use when the user asks for a PDF of a structured document, such as an invoice, receipt, quote, certificate or resume, that a template covers. Uses the user's makesPDF credits: 1 credit per 10 pages. Returns JSON metadata (pageCount, creditsDeducted, creditsRemaining, artifactId, downloadUrl) plus the PDF bytes as an embedded base64 resource and a resource_link to `downloadUrl`. On the Free and Hobbyist plans, unless the account holds Growth credits, each page carries a small makespdf.com link. Mirrors POST /api/v1/render with the { templateId, data } body shape.

templateId.description: Template ID — slug for library rows (e.g. 'invoice-classic') or UUID for user rows.

data.description: Binding data substituted into {{var}} expressions. When omitted, the `const sampleData` declared inside the template's DSL is used; the separately stored sampleData field is not.

title.description: Document title written to the PDF metadata. PDF viewers show it in the window title instead of the file name. When omitted, the template's saved name is used; a title set in the DSL's doc() is not.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List templates visible to the caller: the curated makesPDF library and the caller's own saved templates. Returns metadata only (no DSL), one page at a time. Mirrors GET /api/v1/templates.

owner.description: Whose templates to list: 'mine' for templates you saved, 'library' for the curated makesPDF catalog, 'all' for both.

category.description: Document type to match exactly. Library templates use 'certificate', 'civic', 'form', 'invoice', 'letter', 'quote', 'receipt', 'report', 'resume', 'shipping-label' and 'statement'; your own templates may use others, shown in the `category` field of earlier results.

tags.description: Comma-separated tags; a template must carry every one to match, e.g. 'receipt,retail'. The `tags` field of earlier results shows the values in use.

q.description: Free text matched as a case-insensitive substring against template names and descriptions.

limit.description: Page size: how many templates to return.

offset.description: How many matching templates to skip, for paging. Add `limit` to it to fetch the next page.

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Fetch a single template (library or caller-owned) by ID, including its full DSL source and sampleData. Mirrors GET /api/v1/templates/:id.

templateId.description: Template ID — slug for library rows (e.g. 'invoice-classic') or UUID for user rows.

tools.name: validate_markdown
tools.description: Validate a markdown document for PDF/UA-1 accessibility issues (heading hierarchy, missing alt text). Cheap — no rendering. Returns JSON { valid, issues: [{ severity, message, path, rule }], summary: { errors, warnings } }; `valid` is false when any issue has severity 'error'. Mirrors POST /api/v1/md/validate.

markdown.description: The GitHub-flavored markdown document to check, exactly as it would be passed to render_markdown. Up to 200KB of text; inline data: image payloads do not count toward that.

tools.name: validate_dsl
tools.description: Validate a PDF template DSL script for structure, tag/style correctness, and accessibility issues. Runs catalog validation plus alt-text checks. Cheap — no rendering. Returns JSON { valid, issues: [{ severity, message, path, rule }], summary: { errors, warnings } }; `valid` is false when any issue has severity 'error', and a script that fails to execute comes back as a single 'dsl-execution' error rather than a tool error. Mirrors POST /api/v1/preview/validate.

dsl.description: The builder DSL script to validate. Must assign `const template = doc(...)`.

data.description: Optional binding data. Falls back to the script's sampleData when omitted.

tools.name: render_dsl_preview
tools.description: Render a DSL template + data to a preview PDF. Free (no credits), always watermarked 'PREVIEW — NOT FOR USE'. Returns JSON metadata plus the PDF bytes as an embedded base64 resource. No artifact is recorded, so there is no download URL or resource link. Mirrors POST /api/v1/preview.

dsl.description: The template source: a builder DSL script that assigns `const template = doc(...)` and optionally `const sampleData = {...}`.

data.description: Optional binding data. Falls back to the script's sampleData when omitted.

title.description: Document title written to the PDF metadata. PDF viewers show it in the window title instead of the file name. When omitted, the title is 'Document'; a title set in the DSL's doc() is not used.

tools.name: save_template
tools.description: Save a user-owned DSL template so it can be rendered later by ID. Validates the DSL with the catalog before persisting. Free (no credits). Optional `sampleData` (any JSON value) is stored with the template and returned whenever the template is fetched, preserving the template's binding shape. Optional `description` is a one-sentence summary surfaced on /templates. Returns { templateId, name, createdAt }.

dsl.description: The builder DSL script to store. It is validated before saving. Up to 512KB.

name.description: Display name shown in list_templates results and on the /templates page.

description.description: One-sentence summary of what the template is for. Shown on /templates list rows and matched by list_templates `q`.

sampleData.description: Optional JSON binding data to persist alongside the template. Returned by get_template.

tools.name: update_template
tools.description: Update a saved template's DSL, name, description, and/or sampleData. Revalidates the DSL when provided. A DSL that differs from the stored one is recorded in the template's revision history (History tab on /templates/:id); sending the same DSL again records nothing, and name, description and sampleData are overwritten without history. For `description` and `sampleData`: pass `null` to clear; omit to leave unchanged. Returns { templateId, name, updatedAt }. Mirrors PUT /api/v1/templates/:id.

templateId.description: Template ID — slug for library rows (e.g. 'invoice-classic') or UUID for user rows.

dsl.description: Replacement builder DSL script; it is validated before saving. Omit to keep the current DSL. Up to 512KB.

name.description: New display name. Omit to keep the current name.

description.description: New one-sentence summary. Pass `null` to clear the stored value; omit the key entirely to leave it unchanged.

sampleData.description: Replacement sample binding data, stored alongside the template and returned by get_template (the web editor loads it into its Render data panel). It does not change what render_template uses without `data`: that is the DSL's own `const sampleData`. `null` clears the stored value; omit to leave it unchanged.

tools.name: delete_template
tools.description: Permanently delete a caller-owned template by ID. This cannot be undone. Library rows cannot be deleted. Returns JSON { templateId, deleted: true }. Mirrors DELETE /api/v1/templates/:id.

templateId.description: Template ID — slug for library rows (e.g. 'invoice-classic') or UUID for user rows.

tools.name: get_render_download_url
tools.description: Re-issue a short-lived signed download URL for a render artifact the caller owns, so a PDF rendered in an earlier turn can be downloaded without the embedded base64 bytes. Free (no credits). Returns JSON { artifactId, downloadUrl, downloadUrlExpiresAt } and a resource_link to the URL. Owner-scoped; links follow the artifact's normal retention. An unknown, unowned, failed or expired artifact returns the same 'Render not found' error.

artifactId.description: UUID of the render artifact — the `artifactId` returned by a render tool, or the `X-Artifact-Id` response header on a REST render.

tools.name: report_feedback
tools.description: Send feedback about this MCP server to the makesPDF team: a tool failure you could not explain, an error message or tool description that was wrong or misleading, a capability that is missing, or a concrete suggestion. The summary is the problem in your own words (what you were trying to do, what you tried, what you expected); it must not contain the user's document text, markdown, DSL source or data values, and a specific render is identified by its artifactId instead. Read by the makesPDF team; nobody replies in real time. Free: no credits are used and the user's renders are unaffected.

kind.description: `stuck` — a tool failed and you could not work out why; `bug` — something behaved incorrectly (a misleading error/description counts); `suggestion` — a missing capability or a concrete improvement.

summary.description: The problem in your own words: what you were doing, what you tried, and what you expected. Describe it rather than pasting the user's document text, markdown, DSL or data.

toolName.description: Optional name of the tool this concerns (e.g. `render_template`).

artifactId.description: Optional UUID of the render artifact this concerns (the `artifactId` returned by a render call or the `X-Artifact-Id` response header).
